source.extraction: Original seven-column PDF table grid and character coordinates; whitespace normalized; chemical scripts preserved in Unicode and HTML. Three Symbol private-use glyphs visually mapped to ≈, ≤ and space on original pages 79, 160 and 201. Unreviewed private-use glyphs rejected. No generated descriptions.
